name: Sa Huynh Culture Museum
nameVi: Bảo tàng Văn hóa Sa Huỳnh
kicker: Sa Huynh jars at 149 Trần Phú
summary: A small museum at 149 Trần Phú with more than a thousand objects from the Sa Huỳnh culture, the early residents of this port about two thousand years ago, each tied to the spot where it was dug up. A few pieces from Bãi Ông on Cù Lao Chàm are older still. Give it a museum hour.
fee: 20,000 VND from 10 Aug 2026, or a combination ticket
heroCaption: The yellow entrance of the Sa Huynh museum

notice.title: Closed on the 10th of each month
notice.body: The museum opens every day except the 10th of the month. Plan around that date.

body: The museum is at 149 Trần Phú, set up in 1994. Its collection is more than a thousand objects from the Sa Huỳnh culture, about two thousand years old, the early residents of this port. Each object is tied to the spot where it was found.

A smaller group comes from Bãi Ông on Cù Lao Chàm and dates to the pre-Sa Huỳnh period, about three thousand years ago. The cases also cover burial customs and the community’s sense of beauty. This is the prehistoric hour. It is not a substitute for the towers at My Son.
It is open every day except the 10th of the month. Entry is part of the old-town ticket.

figures.caption: A Sa Huynh jar in a case
figures.alt: A footed ceramic jar with a wide rim, on display in the Sa Huynh Culture Museum

gettingThere: Walk along Trần Phú to number 149, in the old town.

legs.heading: From the old town
legs.body: Walk along Trần Phú to number 149.

closed: Closed on the 10th of each month.
admissionNote: No separate price for this building. From 10 Aug 2026: 20,000 VND per person per building, the same for every visitor (Da Nang Resolution 98/2026). Heritage centre notices of 26 Jan and 16 Mar 2026: 80,000 VND (streetscape, Chùa Cầu or Miếu Quan Công, and two other works) or 120,000 VND (adds a museum and three other works), usable through a stay of up to three days. A May 2026 article counts those as four and six works. Ask at the booth which ticket is on sale.
